jobs_results.title: Senior DevOps Engineer (m/f/*)
jobs_results.description:
This a Full Remote job, the offer is available from: Spain

Our Engineering community is growing, and we’re now looking for a (Senior) DevOps Engineer (m/f/*) to join our team supporting our global growth.

As (Senior) DevOps Engineer, you steer our DevOps projects using your in-depth experience, best practices, and a collaborative attitude. You lead a team turning customer requirements into complex and reliable deployments. Using Linux, AWS or Azure, and Cloudera Data Platform, you deliver our services directly to clients.

WHAT WE OFFER
• A chance to accelerate your career and work with outstanding colleagues in a supportive learning community split across 3 continents
• Contribute your ideas to our unique projects and make an impact by turning them into reality
• Balance your work and personal life through our workflow organization and decide yourself if you work at home, in the office, or on a hybrid setup
• Annual performance review, and regular feedback cycles, generating... distinct value by connecting colleagues through networks rather than hierarchies
• Individual development plan, professional development opportunities
• Educational resources such as paid certifications, unlimited access to Udemy Business, etc.
• Local, virtual, and global team events, in which UT colleagues become acquainted with one another

This offer from "Ultra Tendency" has been enriched by Jobgether.com and got a 78.75% flex score

jobs_results.title: Software Engineer - DevOps
jobs_results.description:
Requisition Number : 183823Can this position be remote? : Yes

We are a global team of creators, storytellers, technologists, experience originators, innovators and so much more. We believe amazing games and experiences start with teams as diverse as the players and communities we serve.

At Electronic Arts, the only limit is your imagination.

Remote Options within Spain.

We span four continents, bringing together diverse individuals passionate about their craft from across the globe. We partner in every development phase while improving our expertise to create even greater experiences for players.

C&D participates in creating some of the most beloved games and supporting our ongoing live services. Through cutting-edge technology, data-driven insights, and state-of-the-art practices, we drive quality and directly impact players.

We are a learning organization, sharing collaboratively and exploring innovative ways to solve challenges in creating amazing games for millions of... players worldwide.

POSITION OVERVIEW :

The Development Release Engineer is part of a centralized team (DRE). We manage DevOps across EA. You will provide important end-to-end Continuous Integration / Deployment services to several game titles within EA across a variety of platforms.

You will ensure the systems are running smoothly, gather requirements, provide feedback, and manage configuration management and development build / test automation infrastructure solutions.

You will report to the Engineering Manager for the DRE Football team.

RESPONSIBILITIES :
• We maintain scripts and software to build games
• We maintain virtualized automation farms, find and address issues
• Monitor metrics to improve automation systems
• Maintain tools, integrations, and technologies to support a reliable release environment
• Report regular status on assigned tasks and identify project risks

Experience REQUIRED :
• 3+ years Software development experience
• Proficiency in a prominent programming language like Python, Java, Groovy, C#, or Powershell

Beneficial Background :
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field
• Experience initiating and maintaining Jenkins instances
• Experience writing Jenkinsfiles with Groovy
• Experience with parts of our DevOps tool chain Source Control (Git, Perforce, SVN), Chef, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Nomad, or Consul
• Experience with a non-relational / noSQL database such as Elasticsearch, MongoDB, or DynamoDB
• Experience with art pipelines
• Experience with distributed build systems
• Experience with large-scale, high-availability, high-throughput automation systems
• Knowledge in gaming consoles

About Electronic Arts

Everything we do is designed to inspire the world to play. Through our cutting-edge games, innovative services, and powerful technologies, we bring worlds with infinite possibilities to millions of players and fans around the globe.

We’re looking for collaborative and inclusive people with diverse perspectives who will enrich our culture and challenge us.

We take a holistic approach with our benefits program, focusing on physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support our people through every chapter of life.

We provide comprehensive benefit packages and support for a balanced life with paid time off and new parent leave, plus free games and so much more.

Our goal is to provide a safe and respectful workplace that empowers you to thrive in both work and life.

Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
JOB INTRO 🔎

At sync. money we are looking for a ‘super-hero’ DevOps Engineer. An incredible new team player to join our family and help us to make a real difference. Someone that will collaborate with team members to improve the company’s engineering tools, systems, process and data security.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Working with our Development Teams, within a Scrum framework.

• Design and implement robust procedures for deployment to development and production environments to minimise downtime and proactively address information security risks through principles of shared responsibility across our AWS platform.

• Build and implement Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) solutions and automate the code delivery pipeline with the goal of one-click deployments, rollbacks, and parameterised builds.

• Helping our developers with E2E testing, through developing manual checklists or automated scripts API testing.

SKILLS / EXPERIENCE

• Know-How of deploying to AWS... cloud infrastructure.

• Experience of using Cloudformations/Terraform for creating Infrastructure-As-Code.

• Experience with monitoring solutions such as NewRelic, StackDriver, Prometheus, etc.

• Know-How of CI/CD Pipelines and Automated Deployments.

• Experience with Linux and Docker.

• Excellent understanding with Distributed Systems: Scaling, Fault-Tolerance, Load-Balancing, Networking, Security, etc…

• Critical thinker and problem-solving skills.

• Good understanding of Nodejs.

• Have been involved heavily in Automation Testing.

Other skills required as a DevOps Engineer include

• English speaking, with multiple languages beneficial.

• Hardworking, willing to take responsibility but also a co-worker.

• Proactive, willing to get involved with the wider team and helping where possible.

• Being passionate about your job and taking the initiative on coming up with new ideas how we can improve our product, culture and company. You are part of the community but a user too!

• Willing to learn but also to coach others where possible.

• Understanding about the importance of our product, the customer experience to peoples everyday lives and the need to support them where appropriate.

SALARY 💵

Will market competitive and will depend on the location, position and experience of the candidate.

WHO WE ARE 😎

sync. is a young and exciting FinTech company headquartered at Level39 in Canary Wharf in the Centre of London with a second hub in the Historical Centre of Malaga, Spain, right next to the Picasso Museum. Our driving ambition is to save people time and money. It’s what motivates us to come in to work every morning knowing that we could be making a real difference to people’s lives.

We combine the very best of features and services across the market, whilst also creating our own, to make a unique product that can be everything to everyone. We always say that great products and built by great teams. We’re very much on our way to building both but need more great people to achieve all of our lofty goals and ambitions. Are you that person? Apply now

Why the ✖️, crossover, where old banking meets the new world of innovation, disruption and inclusion. We are sync. and you could be too.

Read more about us on our blog or follow our latest news on Twitter.

WHY US 🤔

There are 2 things we love doing. Disrupting the relevant landscape and saving people money. We know what you’re thinking. It’s either “what’s the connection between the two?” or “So do I, so how can I be involved?”. Well we have the answer to both questions, read on…

As a result, we’re now looking for motivated applicants to join our team as we develop our new product. This exciting new project is going to change the way people interact with their finances and will take us to the forefront of alternative banking.

If you have the ambition of working in a truly exciting, forward thinking and passionate company, where your work will have immeasurable impact, here we are!

WHAT WE DO ✖️

We are aiming to lead the way in Smart Open Banking. We allow users to instantly open a current GBP &/or EUR account in minutes and we provide them with the ability to open up to 30+ other currency accounts. Users are able to exchange currencies between their accounts at the best rates and transfer money worldwide and unbeatable rates. Learn more about our features here.

sync.’s USP is to allow users to synchronise all of their financial accounts (bank, credit, loan and mortgage accounts) in one app, as one experience by utilising our AISP snd PISP licenses. By being able to budget, manage and track all of their accounts and expenses in one place, offering our users unrivalled user experience as a money management platform and be their financial advisor.

This then translates into tailored recommendations on how to save time and money through our marketplace of products from numerous financial and retail service providers that we have deals with.

"Our ultimate goal is for our users to better understand their saving, spending and investing habits and to make easy, simple, beautiful and accessible to everyone".

WHAT WE OFFER 🏆

> Salary package that rewards you.

Hard-working, dedicated and talented people deserve to be rewarded and that’s why we offer you a salary and bonus package that will reward you for your contribution.

> Flexible hours for a flexible lifestyle.

We know flexibility is important in this day and age. We also know we can trust you to know when you’re at your best, which is why we encourage working smarter not harder.

> Satisfying and fulfilling.

Both of our offices are stocked with plenty of snacks and drinks for you to enjoy.

> A workplace for you.

Choose between our City Centre office in London or by the beach in Malaga. Regardless of which one you choose we’ll make sure you’re using the best equipment available.

> Discounts to cash in on.

Use our dedicated employee portal to save you time and money at some of your favourite retailers and restaurant.

SOME OTHER BENEFITS 🏆

> An office you can call home.

Use our beautiful office space to organise and run events planned by our team, for our team, for a fun filled evening. Feel free to get involved and organise some yourself!

> Opportunities to Grow.

We love when people join us and stay with us and that’s why we offer you amazing growth opportunities. You have the opportunities for promotions, internal transfers and even international transfers as we look to open up more offices worldwide.

If you want to build sync. in your country or in your city then tell us, push us and help us expand our technology and values to your home.

> Our products are for everyone, and so are our offices.

We value diversity on an individual level. We’re dedicated to creating an environment where people can share their own diverse backgrounds, experiences, perspectives & ideas.

sync. money is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, colour, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

READY TO TAKE THE LEAP? 🚀

Feel like you’re ready to accept the challenge and embark on a new and exciting chapter of your life? Click below to apply for the DevOps Engineer job role at sync. money and let’s make a difference together.

RECRUITERS NOTICE ⚠️

This Role is for direct applications only for a full time position and our HR Department will not be responding to any Recruitment Agencies, software firms or freelancers that contact us.

Sync.Money focuses on Financial Services, Banking, Fin Tech, and Digital Currency. Their company has offices in London and Málaga. They have a small team that's between 11-50 employees. To date, Sync.Money has raised $2.2M of funding; their latest round was closed on July 2019.

You can view their website at http://www.sync.money or find them on Twitter, Facebook, and LinkedIn

Cloud DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
¡Únete al equipo de Operaciones Gluon como Cloud DevOps Engineer en un emocionante entorno de trabajo remoto 100%!

Como Cloud DevOps Engineer en el equipo de Operaciones Gluon, serás responsable del desarrollo de soluciones y operación, garantizando que la plataforma Gluon cumpla con los más altos estándares de seguridad y rendimiento. Tus funciones principales incluirán:
• Operación de la Plataforma Gluon en Cloud AWS, Azure y herramientas ALM como Github, Atlassian Jira & Confluence, SonarQube, Nexus, Cloudbees, JFrog y Hashicorp Vault.
• Despliegue de la Plataforma Gluon en Cloud Pública.
• Automatización de procesos para mejorar la eficiencia operativa.
• Garantizar que las soluciones cumplan con los requisitos de seguridad y los SLAs del servicio.

Requisitos:
• Experiencia sólida en Cloud Pública y Privada, con preferencia en AWS y Azure.
• Experto en el desarrollo de soluciones utilizando Terraform.
• Conocimientos avanzados en Kubernetes, incluyendo Docker, Openshift, AKS... EKS, ECR y Helm.
• Experiencia en herramientas de ALM como Github Actions, Nexus Sonatype, JFrog, SonarQube y Vault.
• Habilidad para desarrollar automatizaciones utilizando Python y Ansible.

Skills Valorables:
• Experiencia en metodologías ágiles como SCRUM y Kanban.
• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación oral y escrita en inglés.
• Capacidad analítica para resolver problemas complejos y tomar decisiones informadas.

¡Si eres un apasionado del desarrollo de soluciones en la nube y buscas un desafío emocionante en un entorno remoto, esta es tu oportunidad! ¡Únete a nuestro equipo y sé parte de un ambiente colaborativo y estimulante! Envía tu CV ahora y comienza tu próxima aventura profesional con nosotros

jobs_results.title: Senior Platform Developer/DevOps
jobs_results.description:
Description

Are you an open-minded and stress-tolerant professional interested in working with Infrastructure and multi-clouds? Do you have a Software Engineering background with Python and the ability to quickly learn new technologies? If it sounds like you, this could be the perfect opportunity to join EPAM as a Senior Platform Developer/DevOps Engineer.

Our teams work in highly agile working environments for Fortune 1000 clients, following XP practices and best CI/CD practices. We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer with open-minded personality, who can join our friendly environment and become a core contributor to our team of experts.

As a Critical Infrastructure Site Reliability Engineer, you will be joining a rapidly evolving department to enable rapid financial service business model changes. We have a huge appetite for change and you will be asked to adapt quickly to take on more responsibility. You will tackle a challenging and varied array of problems in how we gain... further maturity in DevOps tools, processes, and engineering capabilities. You will be an engineer first and foremost, looking for excellent solutions that offer leverage for the company, not just "quick fixes".

Watch the video to learn more about this position:

What You’ll Do

• Provide support for a development team from Ops perspective
• Configure Continuous Integration and Delivery pipelines
• Configure new and already existing environments
• Participate in discussions, influences outcomes, and makes recommendations on feasibility and processes and architecture
• Devise/modify procedures to solve problems considering computer equipment capacity and limitations, operating time, and desired results
• Consult with users and develop business relationships and integrate activities with other IT departments to ensure successful implementation
• Monitor and report to management on the status of project efforts, anticipating/identifying issues that inhibit the attainment of project goals and implementing corrective actions
• Foster and maintain good relationships with customers and IT colleagues to meet expected customer service levels

What You Have

• Demonstrable experience with a leading cloud provider (Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform)
• Enterprise-scale software development and release management experience
• Demonstrable experience with one or several facets of infrastructure (Networking, Compute, Security, IAM, Configuration Automation, etc,)
• Expert knowledge Of at least one programming language (Python, C/C++, Scala, Java, Ruby, etc.)
• Strategic thinking complex problem solving and analytical capabilities
• Assess and rapidly resolve business critical issues during assigned on-call shifts
• Able to WFO (1 or 2 days per week)

We Offer

• WORK & LIFE BALANCE. Enjoy more of your personal time with flexible & remote work options, 24 working days of annual leave and paid time off for numerous public holidays
• CONTINUOUS LEARNING CULTURE. Develop your hard & soft skills with internal training and mentorship opportunities, sponsored professional certification, and access to 18,000+ LinkedIn courses
• CLEAR & DIFFERENT CAREER PATHS. Grow in engineering or managerial direction to become a People Manager, in-depth technical specialist, Solution Architect, or Project/Delivery Manager
• GLOBAL RELOCATION OPPORTUNITIES. EPAM has presence in more than 50 countries globally. Explore opportunities to relocate to a new country, and EPAM will provide relocation support for you and your family
• COMPETITIVE BENEFITS. Benefit from a competitive salary, private health insurance, employee stock purchase plan, special discount programs, plus, internal wellbeing programs to take your career to the next level
• STRONG PROFESSIONAL COMMUNITY. Join a global EPAM community of highly skilled experts and connect with them to solve challenges, exchange ideas, share expertise and make friends

About EPAM

• EPAM is a leading digital transformation services and product engineering company with over 53,150 EPAMers in more than 55 countries and regions . Since 1993, our multidisciplinary teams have been helping make the future real for our clients and communities around the world. In 2018, we opened an office in Spain that quickly grew to over 1,450 EPAMers distributed between the offices in Málaga and Madrid as well as remotely across the country . Description

Are you an open-minded and stress-tolerant professional interested in working with Infrastructure and multi-clouds? Do you have a Software Engineering background with Python and the ability to quickly learn new technologies? If it sounds like you, this could be the perfect opportunity to join EPAM as a Senior Platform Developer/DevOps Engineer.

Our teams work in highly agile working environments for Fortune 1000 clients, following XP practices and best CI/CD practices. We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer with open-minded personality, who can join our friendly environment and become a core contributor to our team of experts.

As a Critical Infrastructure Site Reliability Engineer, you will be joining a rapidly evolving department to enable rapid financial service business model changes. We have a huge appetite for change and you will be asked to adapt quickly to take on more responsibility. You will tackle a challenging and varied array of problems in how we gain... further maturity in DevOps tools, processes, and engineering capabilities. You will be an engineer first and foremost, looking for excellent solutions that offer leverage for the company, not just "quick fixes".

Watch the video to learn more about this position:

What You’ll Do

• Provide support for a development team from Ops perspective
• Configure Continuous Integration and Delivery pipelines
• Configure new and already existing environments
• Participate in discussions, influences outcomes, and makes recommendations on feasibility and processes and architecture
• Devise/modify procedures to solve problems considering computer equipment capacity and limitations, operating time, and desired results
• Consult with users and develop business relationships and integrate activities with other IT departments to ensure successful implementation
• Monitor and report to management on the status of project efforts, anticipating/identifying issues that inhibit the attainment of project goals and implementing corrective actions
• Foster and maintain good relationships with customers and IT colleagues to meet expected customer service levels

What You Have

• Demonstrable experience with a leading cloud provider (Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform)
• Enterprise-scale software development and release management experience
• Demonstrable experience with one or several facets of infrastructure (Networking, Compute, Security, IAM, Configuration Automation, etc,)
• Expert knowledge Of at least one programming language (Python, C/C++, Scala, Java, Ruby, etc.)
• Strategic thinking complex problem solving and analytical capabilities
• Assess and rapidly resolve business critical issues during assigned on-call shifts
• Able to WFO (1 or 2 days per week)

We Offer

• WORK & LIFE BALANCE. Enjoy more of your personal time with flexible & remote work options, 24 working days of annual leave and paid time off for numerous public holidays
• CONTINUOUS LEARNING CULTURE. Develop your hard & soft skills with internal training and mentorship opportunities, sponsored professional certification, and access to 18,000+ LinkedIn courses
• CLEAR & DIFFERENT CAREER PATHS. Grow in engineering or managerial direction to become a People Manager, in-depth technical specialist, Solution Architect, or Project/Delivery Manager
• GLOBAL RELOCATION OPPORTUNITIES. EPAM has presence in more than 50 countries globally. Explore opportunities to relocate to a new country, and EPAM will provide relocation support for you and your family
• COMPETITIVE BENEFITS. Benefit from a competitive salary, private health insurance, employee stock purchase plan, special discount programs, plus, internal wellbeing programs to take your career to the next level
• STRONG PROFESSIONAL COMMUNITY. Join a global EPAM community of highly skilled experts and connect with them to solve challenges, exchange ideas, share expertise and make friends

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Project

Our Client is a banking-as-a-service platform that provides companies with the tools they need to access and read bank accounts, move money, and onboard users with ease through our Open Banking API. We are an international team with a digital focus, tech expertise, and banking experience.

A Fast-growing company where your work will have a tangible impact on our future. You’ll join an international team of experts from tech, entrepreneurship, and banking building a company that is a pioneer in its market space -- a unique opportunity in the fintech landscape.
Role
We are looking for a DevOps Engineer with more than 3 years of experience. You will be:
• Monitoring system performance and resolving issues to ensure optimal functionality, efficiency, and security of the IT infrastructure.
• Conducting routine maintenance tasks, including application updates or downgrades.
• Addressing and resolving Helpdesk queries to offer support to internal departments.
• Managing user access... and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) according to compliance policies.
• Participating in paid on-call duties on a rotating basis, with one-week shifts every three weeks.
• Designing, documenting, and implementing security policies for system protection.
• Leveraging continuous integration tools to identify development issues proactively.
• Creating automated deployment systems through configuration management technologies.

Qualifications
• At least 3 years of experience in a similar role.
• Strong proven experience in the administration of Linux-based systems
• Strong experience with Docker & Kubernetes.
• Fluent in Spanish and English.
• Proven experience working with AWS or Azure.
• Proven experience managing databases and networks
• Proven experience with continuous integration tools (like Jenkins) and monitoring tools (like Riemann, Prometheus, Grafana, or ElasticSearch)
• Critical thinking and great problem-solving skills
• Knowledge of security systems and data backup/recovery will be a plus
• Knowledge of tools like Ansible/Terraform will be a plus

jobs_results.title: SRE/Devops Inglés alto
jobs_results.description:
¿Dónde vas a trabajar?

Empresa internacional

¿Qué harás en tu nuevo puesto?

Responsibilities
• Document and share any work knowledge, incident experiences, and any improvements with the team
• Participate in mentoring and coaching new and junior employees or new members of team
• Participate and contribute to the community of knowledge sharing of SRE practices. For example, Solution Monitoring program
• Implement solution monitoring and observability monitoring, automate detections and responses
• Implement SLI and SLO measurements and monitoring in our Solution Monitoring
• Conduct Service improvement actions and review with the team using data from SLI and SLO
• Troubleshoot incidents, post-incidents analysis, perform root cause analysis
• Implement workarounds to avoid recurrence of incidents, improvements to monitoring detection
• Implement Observability monitoring and perform distributed tracing analysis of applications
• Deployment of new application releases to the... preproduction and production environments
• Participate and contribute to automation in deployment, automated testing, and monitoring detection
• Collaborate with SQC team on testing automation deployment
• Collaborate with DevOps on continuous delivery
• Participate in solution FAT process and performance tests
• Drive the solution SAT process in collaboration with Development, DevOps, Platform teams
• Participate in the planning and review sessions with Development, DevOps, Platform teams
• Expand and grow the technical knowledge, skillsets, and expertise expected of an SRE
• Create and document any artifacts related to SRE practices, for example, good practices or patterns or customized dashboards or workarounds or troubleshooting methods, solution monitoring and observability improvements.
• ¿A quién buscamos (H/M/D)?

Knowledge, skills:

Language skills: Fluent in English

Others: Good written and verbal communication

Technical skills:

· Experience in troubleshooting or debugging applications and complex systems

· Understand application tracing and log analysis

· Strong knowledge of Linux and VM

· Hands-on experience in Shell Scripts

· Experience in application deployment, and deployment tools (e.g. Jenkins)

· Experience in programming and development at least one programming language (e.g. Python, C, Java, etc).

· Experience with incident resolution and root cause analysis and incident management

· Knowledge and experience in using JIRA, a ITSM ticketing tool and any documentation tools (e.g. Wiki)

· Knowledge and experience in Nagios and Splunk or similar tools

· Knowledge and experience in Dockers, OpenShift, Kubernetes or similar technologies

· Knowledge and experience in automation (e.g. Ansible) will be an advantage

¿Cuáles son tus beneficios?

50% remoto

jobs_results.title: Junior IAM DevOps Developer
jobs_results.description:
OSP (Otto Group Solution Provider) is an IT service provider for retail and logistics with headquarters in Dresden. We live our passion for IT in an appreciative, trusting work environment. What drives us is the idea of working together as a team to achieve great things for our customers.

We rely on the personal responsibility and willingness to learn of our employees, on modern technologies and high quality in software development. Agile working, transparent decisions, a lively feedback culture and collegial cooperation make us successful.

We are active for customers inside and outside the Otto Group. With over 450 employees at several German and international locations, we have been developing flexible software and BI solutions since 1991 and are thus shaping the shopping worlds of tomorrow. We are part of the Otto Group and share a value system that focuses on responsible and sustainable action.

What will you do?
• Our team take care of workplace-related hardware, collaboration... platforms such as M365 and communication services - with state-of-the-art technology that fits perfectly. In particular, we - the Automation Services team - are part of the division responsible for the operation and further development of the Identity and Access Management (IAM).
• Our platform ensures that everyone has all the hardware, software, and access rights needed to be productive in the given moment.
• We ensure the complete and automated User Life Cycle for all colleagues - for joiners, movers and leavers.
• You would be part of a team with 12 highly motivated experts looking forward to work with you and bring you up to speed with our IAM world!

What's your story?
• You have a high customer focus.
• You are highly motivated to ensure our operations quality and service availability (DevOps).
• You have basic knowledge in back and front-end development.
• You have very good knowledge of English speaking and writing.

Nice to have:
- Basic knowledge of SQL, Active Directory, as well as interface programming.
Basic knowledge of One Identity, Azure, AWS, GCP, ….

Contact

Mariel Mantecas
Otto Group Solution Provider Spain S.L.
Calle del Conde de Peñalver 38, 1ª planta | 28006 Madrid
mariel.mantecas(at)ottogroup.com

jobs_results.title: DevOps & Kubernetes Engineer (Temporary)
jobs_results.description: La posizione As DevOps & Kubernetes Engineer will play a main role in the creation and adoption of a devops mindset in different development teams, providing guidance and support for understanding how to develop and deploy cloud native applications that will consistently run on a kubernetes based environment. You will also contribute to the evolution, maintenance and continuous improvement of Container as a Service (CaaS) ecosystem on hybrid cloud deployment, ensuring services meet operational targets, and achieve high availability and performance in meeting Roche’s business needs. You will be part of the CaaS Product team, a global team with members in EMEA, NALA and ASIA. Your mail role will be connecting and supporting our internal consumers, including helping them to understand and translate business demand into technical solutions, and being the link between developers and CaaS Product Team You will also work with the developers in guiding them to create and deploy cloud native... applications and how to operate successfully in a kubernetes environment, both in cloud (AWS) and on premise. All this, you will perform for the good of the patients, in a leading global healthcare company Who are we and how do we work? The CaaS (Container as a Service) Product team is an infrastructure team that delivers and maintains high available kubernetes platform for multiple applications in Roche. For that purpose we provide automated processes and ensure our platform works seamlessly for our users, including a global toolchain (security, monitoring, logging, SSO etc.) We work following agile principles. Required Experience 4+ years of professional experience in DevOps, 5+ years in IT in general. Strong experience with Docker and Kubernetes. CKAD - Certified Kubernetes Application Developer is a plus. Programming skills in scripting languages like Python, Bash. Expert knowledge of implementing CI/CD pipelines and delivering reliable software from development to production. Hands-on experience with infrastructure automation (Ansible, Terraform). Strong knowledge of infrastructure and networking (DNS, Load Balancing, Firewalls, Routing, Web). Good knowledge of Linux systems. Experience in DevOps teams organization, DevOps toolchain implementation. Knowledge of tools used in the CaaS Ecosystem (Rancher, Portworx, Aqua, Nexus, Elastic) Experience with cloud platforms - preferably AWS is a plus. Highly fluent oral and written communication skills in English Very good communication skills and willingness to interact with development teams and help them to adopt best cloud native based development and deployment practices Strong team oriented mindset. Innovative and ability to think outside the box for creative problem solving Ability to learn and propose new technologies/tools and teach how to integrate them to other users/teams Experience working in Agile Teams. SAFe is a plus. Accountabilities Guide, support and closely collaborate with development and infrastructure teams. Mentoring and sharing DevOps culture and knowledge with your colleagues Building and enhancing large-scale platforms and applications. Establish best practices for consistency among software development teams. Designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines across the organization. Identifying and implementing automation strategies that ensure high quality and speed up delivery of new solutions. Consistently deliver robust, high-quality, reliable outcomes in cross functional autonomous agile teams. Drive scripting and IaC development to achieve the highest levels of automation and use of APIs, enabling continuous integration and delivery. Manage CaaS-as-a-Service delivery, systems reliability and scalability including: configuration, building, testing, planning, and deployment of complex solutions Install, configure, upgrade, troubleshoot, and proactively monitor and ensure performance, availability and capacity. Comply with OLAs and quality and validation requirements. "At Roche, we believe in diversity and inclusion as essential values for our success. We have special interest in integrating people with disabilities into our teams. If you have a disability, forus it is a plus, and we have special benefits for you: Go ahead and present your candidacy! Chi siamo Presente in 100 Paesi con più di 100,000 dipendenti, Roche è leader mondiale nelle biotecnologie e focalizza il proprio impegno nella ricerca e sviluppo di nuove tecnologie diagnostiche e farmaci personalizzati. Roche è un'azienda che garantisce le pari opportunità. Crediamo sia urgente fornire soluzioni mediche adesso, e contemporaneamente sviluppare innovazioni terapeutiche e diagnostiche per il futuro. Agiamo con passione e impegno per migliorare la vita dei pazienti. Abbiamo il coraggio di decidere e di agire. E riteniamo che lavorare in modo responsabile e sostenibile contribuisca a creare un mondo migliore. Questa convinzione ispira il nostro lavoro ogni giorno. Ci impegniamo a svolgere la nostra attività con rigore scientifico, etica e integrita' incontestabili e a garantire l'accesso a innovazioni mediche per tutti. Facciamo questo oggi per costruire un domani migliore. Siamo orgogliosi della nostra identità, di quello che facciamo e di come lo facciamo. Siamo tante persone, ma lavoriamo come se fossimo una sola, attraverso tutte le funzioni, le aziende del gruppo e in tutto il mondo. Noi siamo Roche
